notes.title: the New Game PLUS Update!
notes.notes:
New stuff
- New Game Plus added to the game
- New sidequest (only available on new game plus)
- You can now skip the game intro
- Some quality of life tweaks here and there
- Fixed a bug that caused high level monster to appear in the spring factory entrance for lower difficulties
- Fixed a moving platform in the spring factory area

How do I start a new game+?
once you beat the game, you can restart any saved game as new game plus. Your weapons, powerups and maps will be preserved so you can keep growing stronger!

How do I enter the new sidequest zone?
Once you start a new game plus, play as normal until you reach Treasure Island I. Go to the leftmost part of the island and a new building will be there. Inside you'll start your trip to the new area.

notes.title: v1.3.0 The difficulty modes update!
notes.notes:
Difficulty Settings Update is here!
Hello there! This update brings difficulty options to Trapers Platformer! The game is supposed to be challenging indeed, but if the bosses or jumps get too infuriating for you, there are not one, but TWO easier game modes to try! And if you are into suffering and pain there's a harder game mode too! Yay!

So if you got frustrated in the past, don't be ashamed to start over and enjoy the charming story behind Trapers Platformer. The difficulty selection screen is available when you start a new game, and your existing saves will be labelled as "classic" difficulty.

So what's next?
V1.4.0 Will be the last content update, and will feature the long awaited new game+! Keep an eye on the news for updates on this matter ;)

Hey! I Found a bug!
Something not working as expected? Or perhaps you still find the game too hard? Don't be afraid to report whatever you find! Your feedback makes the game better.
